dataset.12G_expansion: excluded unless an independent live authority already marks a case SCIENTIFIC_VALID; none substituted in the frozen 20G study
dataset.target_truth: current SCIENTIFIC_VALID integrated 3D PW only; PW_COMPLEX_FLOQUET_STATE_V1; POSTNP; C_PW/C_hat/P_scale factorization

A1.inputs: six ordered geometry values concatenated with the 88 V2 LF proxy fields; exactly the fields/order in feature_manifest_v2.json
A1.name: NP_LF_PHYSICS_V2

A3.reason: A2 is unavailable; do not manufacture A3

feature_value_acceptance.blocked: formal matched labels/provider values are insufficient or fail integrity/coverage gates
feature_value_acceptance.not_supported: no meaningful incremental improvement or consistent degradation
feature_value_acceptance.partial: measurable but target-specific/small improvement, OOD-stratum sensitivity, or unstable q95/worst-case behavior
feature_value_acceptance.production_H1_is_separate: all frozen conjunctive H1 gates must pass; feature utility never implies production admission
feature_value_acceptance.supported: at least one legal NP arm improves both state and routing median RMSE by >=5%, wins on >=60% of geometries for both endpoints (12/20 for 20G; 20/32 for 32G), and does not worsen state/routing q95 by >10% or worst-case error by >25%; key absolute-order and total-power medians/q95 must not materially degrade; report OOD strata and seed stability

absolute_order: meaningful-power thresholded relative error; frozen threshold 0.0009885656815447454
metrics.primary_question: Does deterministic low-fidelity NP physics improve unseen-geometry prediction of integrated 3D PW state? This is incremental auxiliary-feature value, not standalone NP accuracy.
metrics.scope: paired 445..455 nm only; no full-band 440..460 comparison

model.architecture: Linear(6,32)-ReLU-Linear(32,32)-ReLU; seven Linear(32,2) order heads; concatenate 14 latent values; Linear(14,32)-ReLU-Linear(32,14) residual fusion; output=local+fusion
model.early_stopping_objective: training-normalized latent MSE on geometry-held inner validation
model.final_fit_epoch_rule: for each seed, use the median best epoch across the three inner folds, then refit on all outer-training geometries for that epoch count; no outer-test feedback
model.p_scale_model: RBF Kernel Ridge; StandardScaler X/y fit on each training fold; alpha={0.1,1,10}, gamma={0.1,1}; 3-fold grouped inner selection by minimum mean normalized MSE
model.prediction_aggregation: arithmetic mean of all three fixed-seed predictions; no seed selection

np_interface.hf22_support: 0/20 exact overlap; 20/20 OOD; runtime coverage is not an OOD accuracy claim
known_provenance_warnings: D180 setup heartbeat pre-FSP path now contains different bytes; do not treat the current file as the setup artifact
D180 run_manifest pre_fsp pointer does not match setup heartbeat; setup hash is retained from the heartbeat, but the referenced pre-FSP bytes are not currently recoverable
np_interface.runtime_sample_parity: 15 deterministic samples, exact feature and provenance match; zero mismatch

ood_stratification.future_32g_reuse: exact same contract and stratification policy; derive 20/32 thirds via stable distance/case_id ordering

physical_boundary.NP_features: low-fidelity single-pillar DFT order-power proxies only
physical_boundary.not: standalone NP truth, integrated MDC-NP truth, exact C_component, complex scattering operator, Jones response
physical_boundary.prohibited: do not multiply by MDC TMM phase or construct component-residual model

preprocessing.A0: ordered D1..D6 divided by 130 nm, StandardScaler fit on outer-training geometries only
preprocessing.A1: concatenate the six ordered geometry values and 88 wavelength-major LF fields; StandardScaler then PCA to six input components, each fit only on the relevant training geometries; same frozen width-32 model capacity as A0
preprocessing.p_scale_x: arm-specific six-dimensional processed input; scaling fit on training only
preprocessing.scale_target: POSTNP_TOTAL_POWER_V2/P_scale, paired 445..455 nm only; no oracle substitution
preprocessing.state_target: seven order-local rank-2 PCA bases fit only on training geometries using paired 445..455 nm complex TE/TM spectral coordinates

split.inner: three grouped geometry folds within each outer-training set
split.outer: strict 20-fold LOGO by complete ordered geometry

v1_history.historical_v1_outcome: COUPLING_ML_NP_FORWARD_FEATURE_ABLATION_BLOCKED; old interface could not legally provide paired runtime features
v1_history.v2_changes: NP interface V2 deterministic LF feature availability/runtime semantics only; no V1 artifacts overwritten
